resources.string: Home screen and agenda · Breezy Weather
Show weather beside the date and in your agenda.
Built-in weather uses the locations and forecasts saved in Breezy Weather. Allow access to share that data with Grace Launcher.
Turn on weather to connect to Breezy Weather.
Install Breezy Weather to use built-in weather. Without it, this feature stays unavailable.
Allow Grace Launcher to read weather shared by Breezy Weather.
Add a location in Breezy Weather, then return here.
Open Breezy Weather and refresh the forecast for this location, then return here.
Check for updates to Grace Launcher and Breezy Weather to use compatible versions of weather sharing.
Breezy Weather could not share its data. Open it to check the forecast, then try again.
For prompt updates, enable Grace Launcher in Breezy Weather → Settings → External modules → Location Update Notifier. Weather is still checked when you return to Grace Launcher.
